scenes.title: Old Survivors
scenes.text: Some trees have been alive for thousands of years, standing through empires rising and falling around them.

scenes.title: Clean The Air
scenes.text: Trees pull carbon from the air and release fresh oxygen, quietly cleaning the planet every single day.

scenes.title: Forest Internet
scenes.text: Scientists have found that trees can share nutrients through underground fungal networks linking their roots.

scenes.title: Living Cities
scenes.text: A single large tree can be home to thousands of insects, birds, and other creatures all at once.

scenes.title: Deep Roots
scenes.text: Roots can grow far deeper than the tree is tall, anchoring it against storms and searching for water.

scenes.title: Cooler Cities
scenes.text: Streets lined with trees stay noticeably cooler in summer, cutting heat and shading everyone below.

scenes.title: Make Rain
scenes.text: Forests release so much water vapor that they help create their own rain, keeping whole regions green.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Trees quietly hold the world together. If you could plant one tree, where would you put it?
